I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team. I couldn't confirm or rule out the 8 April renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co. from anything she can see.

- **What I checked:** #central-team, the other Central channels and the public files. None of them gives a Brackenwater renewal date.
- **Who owns the account:** Brackenwater is a North account. A public North digest from 14 Sep 2025 says it moved to Marcus Lindqvist on 15 Sep 2025. I pointed her to him or the North team to check the date against the signed paperwork.
- **What I asked her:** not to treat 8 April as the real date until someone confirms it.

I didn't look up or mention anything from North-only records, because Pree isn't on that team. My reply says I've "noted" the date as unverified, but that only means I acknowledged it. I didn't save it anywhere or contact Marcus.
